info.name: Ashby API Key Application Form API

items.docs:
Submit an application for a job posting.

**Requires the [`candidatesWrite`](authentication#permissions-applicationformsubmit) permission.**

The Content-Type of this request must be `multipart/form-data` or `application/json`.

When using `application/json`, file fields should contain a handle string obtained from [`file.createFileUploadHandle`](https://developers.ashbyhq.com/reference/filecreatefileuploadhandle) with `fileUploadContext` set to `ApplicationForm`. This allows files to be uploade
